headline: TIF: Mitsotakis to Announce Minimum Wage at €1,000 – €500 Allowance in the Public Sector, €400 for Pensioners
summary: Prime Minister Mitsotakis is set to announce a €1,000 minimum wage at the Thessaloniki International Fair. Measures also include a €500 public-sector allowance, a €400 pensioner payment and wage increases.
why: Minimum wage and public-sector pay decisions shape Greek household spending, labour costs and the fiscal budget. Banks and domestic-facing companies are typically sensitive to such measures.
